verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud provider, so region and residency choice is a fair axis. Its docs say users can run applications closer to their users, which implies the product offers its own deployment-region selection. That evidence concerns compute placement for latency rather than data storage or residency guarantees. missing for 10: explicit documentation that users can pick the region where data and volumes are stored, a list of available regions, data-residency or compliance commitments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run your application closer to where your users are.
